turns.content: Derive the finite entropy change for n moles taken from (T_i,P_i) to (T_f,P_f) when C_{P,m} may depend on temperature. The sample considered below contains 2.50 mol of CO2.
For this case, integrate C_{P,m}/T analytically to obtain the molar temperature contribution.
Evaluate that molar temperature contribution up to T_f=800 K.
Evaluate the molar pressure contribution up to P_f=3.45 bar, using R=8.314 J mol^-1 K^-1.
Combine the two molar contributions and use n=2.50 mol to calculate the total entropy change of the CO2 sample.
Explain the sign of the pressure contribution and how it modifies the positive entropy change from heating.
Check the calculation by describing an equivalent reversible two-step path and verify that the temperature and pressure terms correspond to those two steps.
Report the total entropy change in J K^-1 and summarize the contributions that determine it.
